title: Zahari greets John Paul at their first meeting, a friendship made on the Hill

tellings.quote: when zahari walked into the house he's like hey John Paul blah they had this whole relationship and they said it had been built on the hill

plain: In 2023 in Georgia, a nonspeaking boy named Zahari is said to have walked into a house and greeted another boy, John Paul, as an old friend, though they were meeting for the first time, and the two said their friendship had been built "on the hill," a place they meet without being there in body. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about children said to share thoughts by telepathy, tells Michels what she was told, with a woman named Libby among her sources. If true, the boys would have known each other only through their minds.
